technology_name: RADIALLY CONTRACTING TOROIDAL PNEUMATIC ARTIFICIAL MUSCLE
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
technology_type: Soft Robotics Actuator / Pneumatic Artificial Muscle
problem_solved: Conventional linear pneumatic cylinders are heavy, require perfectly rigid mounting links, leak easily under side-loads, and lack structural compliance for soft human-robot collaboration setups.
description: An advanced soft robotic actuator comprising a flexible internal tube completely enclosed inside a radially contracting braided sleeve mesh, structurally secured at both boundaries by heavy-duty muscle-by-muscle coupling manifolds to apply uniform concentric forces.
applications: Soft robotic gripper systems, medical assistive bio-mechatronic braces, collaborative industrial assembly arms, and biomimetic legged locomotive robots.
secondary_sector: MedTech & Health Care, Infrastructure, Construction & Smart Cities
